en: Consolidate the PostgreSQL, Worker, and Docker runtimes around current Session execution; remove the generic outbox runtime, operations facade, bundled OpenTelemetry adapters, orphaned credential and egress abstractions, and unsupported DeepSeek request helpers.
zh-CN: 围绕当前 Session 执行合并 PostgreSQL、Worker 与 Docker runtime；移除通用 outbox runtime、运维 facade、内置 OpenTelemetry adapter、无 owner 的凭据与网络出口抽象，以及不再支持的 DeepSeek 请求辅助 API。
